title: Adds `design_rejected` as a possible cancellation reason for issued cards
summary: design_rejected is now a possible value for the cancellation_reason field on the issued card object, indicating that the card’s design was rejected by Stripe.

migrationNotes.text: The Card object now includes design_rejected as a possible value for the cancellation_reason field, indicating Stripe’s rejection of the card design.

sources.quote: | [Adds `design_rejected` as a possible cancellation reason for issued cards](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/2022-08-01/adds-design-rejected-value-cards.md) | Issuing | Breaking | api |
`design_rejected` is now a possible value for the `cancellation_reason` field on the `issued card` object, indicating that the card’s design was rejected by Stripe.
